Landing pages: review before the admin is built

Session 4.10 · arrow keys work
Carried from Session 4.8, for you to confirm or change:
  • The page uses the small emblem logo (the one in the site header), not the larger Booth Proof logo.
  • The page is white, with a navy band behind the button (the band carries a soft teal glow).
  • The picture and text in these screens are test content made for this review, not a real offer.
  • Andy should brand-check the first sample page: colours, fonts, logo and contact details.

Screen 1 of 6

Live page, computer

A live landing page as a visitor sees it on a computer (1280 px wide), whole page top to bottom: small emblem logo, eyebrow, headline with a teal second line, picture, copy with bullets, the navy band with the button, then the footer.

What to judge

  • Headline size and weight
  • Picture crop and rounded corners
  • Button colour and label on the navy band
  • Overall: does it feel like Your AV Department?

Whole page shown. Click the picture to see it full size and scroll; click again to fit.

Live page, phone

The same page on a phone (390 px wide). The button becomes full width.

What to judge

  • Headline wraps cleanly and is not too big
  • Picture still reads at phone size
  • Copy is comfortable to read
  • Button is easy to tap

Screen 3 of 6

Expired page with popup, computer

The page after its offer has ended. The page button is gone and, about half a second after the page loads, the expiration popup opens over it. Wording, button and email come word for word from the contract.

What to judge

  • Popup wording reads well (changing it needs your word; it lives in the contract)
  • Contact button: colour and label
  • Email link beneath
  • Close mark (top right) is easy to find

Screen 4 of 6

Expired page with popup, phone

The same expired page on a phone. The popup fits the screen, the Contact button is full width, and the close mark is a full size tap target.

What to judge

  • Popup is readable and not cramped
  • Nothing is cut off
  • Easy to close
